tx(ax_c, cx_c, 0.13, '0.694', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', color='#2D6A2D')

os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/fig2_framework.pdf', format='pdf')

print(f'Saved fig2 to {out_dir}/')
